scripts.dev: node scripts/copy-public-assets.mjs && tailwindcss -i styles/design-system.css -o public/pos.css --content app/pos/index.html && tailwindcss -i styles/dashboard-utilities.css -o app/src/pages/dashboard-utilities.generated.css --content app/src/pages/OwnerDashboard.tsx && vite --host 127.0.0.1
